description: Get a link that plays a simulated 3D tour of a resort in the EM Snow flyby (lifts up, named runs down, on the mapped piste network), or a tour of runs you name. Pick names match like route_on_mountain; ambiguous names return candidates with picker ids. Status is ready, limited (small mapped network, the tour may be short) or unavailable (too few named runs or no linking lifts; the resort page is returned instead).
name: fly_this_mountain
title: Fly this mountain
